items.title: Is Elevance Health (ELV) Still A Bargain After A 38% Gain?
items.summary: Elevance Health has delivered a 37.6% gain over the past year, yet current valuation checks still lean on the side of the stock looking inexpensive rather than stretched. For investors, that creates a pricing debate around how much of the company’s recent health data partnerships and care model initiatives is already reflected in today’s US$398.22 share price.
